title: metastelma pubescens
intro: Metastelma pubescens, commonly known as the hairy Metastelma, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Metastelma pubescens include its use in treating various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
